CONTRACT OF EMPLOYMENT

This Contract is dated 14 April 2026 and is made between HALBROOK DIAGNOSTICS LIMITED, a company incorporated in England and Wales with company number 08765432 whose registered office is at 40 Rosenthaler Street, Manchester M1 2AB (the "Company"), and DEVON ACHEBE of 88 Beech Row, Manchester M4 5CD (the "Employee").

This Contract sets out the particulars of employment required by section 1 of the Employment Rights Act 1996.

1. COMMENCEMENT AND CONTINUOUS EMPLOYMENT
1.1 Your employment begins on 1 June 2026. No employment with a previous employer counts towards your period of continuous employment.

2. JOB TITLE AND DUTIES
2.1 You are employed as Head of Laboratory Operations. You shall perform the duties reasonably assigned to you and shall use your best endeavours to promote the interests of the Company.

3. PLACE OF WORK
3.1 Your normal place of work is the Company's Manchester site. You may be required to work at any other Company site in the United Kingdom on reasonable notice. You are not required to work outside the United Kingdom for any period.

4. HOURS OF WORK
4.1 Your normal hours are 9.00 am to 5.30 pm Monday to Friday, with one hour for lunch. You may be required to work such additional hours as are necessary for the proper performance of your duties, without further payment.
4.2 You agree that regulation 4(1) of the Working Time Regulations 1998 (the 48-hour average weekly limit) shall not apply to you. You may withdraw this agreement by giving the Company three months' written notice.

5. SALARY
5.1 Your salary is £86,000 per year, payable monthly in arrears on or about the 25th of each month by credit transfer, subject to deductions for income tax and National Insurance.
5.2 The Company will review your salary annually. A review does not imply an increase.

6. PENSION
6.1 You will be enrolled in the Company's qualifying workplace pension scheme in accordance with its automatic enrolment obligations under the Pensions Act 2008. Employer contributions are 5% of qualifying earnings. A contracting-out certificate is not in force.

7. HOLIDAY
7.1 Your holiday entitlement is 25 days per holiday year plus the usual public holidays in England. The holiday year runs from 1 January to 31 December. Holiday accrues at 1/12th of the annual entitlement for each completed month.
7.2 On termination you will be paid in lieu of accrued untaken holiday, and the Company may deduct from your final payment the value of any holiday taken in excess of entitlement, which you authorise as a deduction under section 13 of the Employment Rights Act 1996.

8. SICKNESS ABSENCE
8.1 If you are absent through sickness you must notify your line manager by 9.30 am on the first day. The Company pays Statutory Sick Pay only. The qualifying days for SSP are Monday to Friday.

9. NOTICE
9.1 Either party may terminate on the notice set out below: during the first month, one week; thereafter, three months from either party. The Company is not obliged to provide work during any notice period and may place you on garden leave.
9.2 Nothing in this clause affects your statutory right to notice under section 86 of the Employment Rights Act 1996, and the notice the Company gives will never be less than that.

10. CONFIDENTIALITY
10.1 You shall not use or disclose the Company's confidential information during or after your employment. Nothing in this Contract prevents you from making a protected disclosure under the Public Interest Disclosure Act 1998, or from reporting a matter to a regulator.

11. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS
11.1 For six months after termination you shall not solicit any customer with whom you dealt in the twelve months before termination, and shall not solicit any employee with whom you worked in that period. These restrictions are no wider than is reasonably necessary to protect the Company's legitimate business interests.

12. DISCIPLINARY AND GRIEVANCE
12.1 The Company's disciplinary and grievance procedures are set out in the Staff Handbook and do not form part of this Contract. A grievance should be raised in writing with the HR Director.

13. COLLECTIVE AGREEMENTS
13.1 No collective agreement directly affects your terms and conditions.

14. DATA PROTECTION
14.1 The Company processes your personal data in accordance with its Employee Privacy Notice and the UK GDPR.

15. ENTIRE AGREEMENT
15.1 This Contract, and the documents referred to in it, constitute the entire terms of your employment and supersede all previous arrangements.

16. GOVERNING LAW
16.1 This Contract is governed by the law of England and Wales, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the employment tribunals and courts of England and Wales.

Signed for and on behalf of HALBROOK DIAGNOSTICS LIMITED

/s/ Marisol Trent
Director

I have read and accept these terms.

/s/ Devon Achebe
Devon Achebe
